pronunciation: fluid — "Meet-tuh-Manage", like "meet to manage your day" (carried over from the prior v6 project; reconfirm at VO sign-off)
audience: Existing customers — onboarding tour of the full product, one portal at a time
tone: walkthrough/how-to, second person ("as an admin, you..."), no hard sell
cta: Sign in and explore your portal (not a sales CTA — no 'Book a Demo')
theme: forced light — page.addInitScript sets localStorage['trn.theme']='light' before every navigation, regardless of OS color-scheme

brand.note: real site tokens (--primary 214 52% 25%, --brand-accent 3 79% 53%), not the v6 project's #F97316 approximation. Used for chapter cards, the CTA end card, and the logo wordmark.

recording_mode: single continuous take (one browser session, demo-mode role switching via /portal-select — no real backend/credentials needed). Chapter beats (01, 12, 13) use the same custom animated overlay style as v6 (fade-up text + slow Ken Burns pan on a navy/coral gradient backdrop) with crossfades between all beats. Each portal beat's callout pill is tinted with that role's own brand hex from role_colors, so the color-coding on screen matches the app's own role colors.
recording_risk_note: RESOLVED after recon: the demo-mode Live Classroom (/teacher/live/:sessionId) is fully mocked — initials-avatar tiles, seeded participants/leaderboard, no real getUserMedia/Jitsi connection attempted. Safe to record directly, no fallback needed.
